description: Execute a Zendesk view to retrieve its column titles and matching ticket rows. Use when you need to run a saved view and get its results - useful for checking which tickets match a view's conditions without manually applying filters. Supports pagination, custom sorting, and optional grouping of results. Returns the view's execution metadata alongside the matching rows.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for executing a Zendesk view.

exclude.description: A comma-separated list of sideloads to exclude from the response
exclude.human_parameter_description: Specify data to exclude from the response.
exclude.title: Exclude

group_by.description: The ticket field used for grouping. This will either be a title or a custom field id.
group_by.human_parameter_description: Choose a ticket field to group results by (e.g., status, priority).
group_by.title: Group By

include.description: A comma-separated list of sideloads to include in the response
include.human_parameter_description: Specify additional data to include in the response (e.g., users, groups).
include.title: Include

page.description: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: Traditional: `?page=2` (integer page number). Cursor: `?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor` (deepObject with size, after, before). These are mutually exclusive - use one format or the other, not both.
page.human_parameter_description: Which page of results to retrieve. Supports either page number or cursor-based pagination.
page.title: Page

sort_by.description: The ticket field used for sorting. This will either be a title or a custom field id.
sort_by.human_parameter_description: Choose which ticket field to sort results by (e.g., status, updated_at, priority).
sort_by.title: Sort By

sort_order.description: The direction the tickets are sorted. May be one of 'asc' or 'desc'
sort_order.human_parameter_description: Choose ascending (asc) or descending (desc) order for sorting.
sort_order.title: Sort Order

view_id.description: The ID of the view to execute
view_id.human_parameter_description: The unique identifier of the Zendesk view you want to execute. You can find this ID in the view URL or from a views list.
view_id.title: View Id
